name: parity-reference-binary
command:
import os,sys,subprocess,json,pathlib
base=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
e=dict(os.environ);e["POLARIS_CONFIG_DIR"]=str(base/"config-must-not-be-created")
records=[]
for name in json.loads(sys.argv[3]):
 r=subprocess.run([sys.argv[2],"--scenario",name,"--theme","dark","--color","always","--dump","120x40"],env=e,capture_output=True,timeout=15)
 (base/(name+".txt")).write_bytes(r.stdout)
 records.append({"scenario":name,"exit":r.returncode,"bytes":len(r.stdout),"stderr":r.stderr.decode("utf8","replace")})
print(json.dumps({"records":records,"config_created":(base/"config-must-not-be-created").exists()},indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if all(x["exit"]==0 for x in records) else 1)
